entities.name: Tasigur
entities.description: Young, cruel human khan of the Sultai Brood in Tarkir's past, who became Silumgar's slave.

entities.name: Sultai Brood
entities.description: Clan ruled by humans then, led by Tasigur.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: Dragon progenitor to whom Tasigur gifted his jade throne and who enslaved him.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: Dragonlord whose dragons won over the khans.

entities.name: Khanfall of Tarkir
entities.description: Event in which dragons won over the khans and clans.

events.summary: Tasigur disrespects the rakshasa Khudal; the Sultai lose control of their undead and are abandoned by the naga.
events.quote: Due to his disrespect of a Rakshasa named Khudal

events.summary: Tasigur attempts to gift Silumgar his jade throne.
events.quote: Tasigur attempted to gift the dragon progenitor Silumgar with his jade throne

events.summary: Tasigur leads the dragon's brood into the khans' meeting, causing the Khanfall; he becomes Silumgar's slave.
events.quote: Tasigur was rewarded for this by becoming Silumgar's slave

relations.quote: During his time, humans still ruled the Sultai Brood .
Tasigur was rewarded for this by becoming Silumgar's slave
